_comment: Trigger A (compliance path): the hardening index falling below baseline.
This is the trigger named in the Phase 4 brief. It is the slower of the
two, and deliberately so: it measures the posture of the whole host rather
than the integrity of a specific file.
Its remediation is verified against the index itself, because the index is
the condition it fired on. See verification_passed() in the daemon.
name: Lynis Hardening Index Below Baseline (85)
